req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject player creation requests with an invalid id type by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This ensures data integrity by validating input types before processing. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct behavior with valid input, a negative case to test the rejection of invalid input, and a boundary case to test the edge of valid input types.

tests.name: test_create_player_with_valid_id
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The player creation endpoint is available.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid integer id.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert "id" in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_player_with_invalid_id_type
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The player creation endpoint is available.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a non-integer id.
expected: The response indicates a validation error.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": "ten",
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "detail" in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_player_with_boundary_id_type
